findings.title: Wrong event listener removed in dispose
findings.body: The `dispose` method removes the `"message"` event listener bound to `this.onMessage` but leaves the `"close"` listener bound to `this.onClose` intact. The code previously removed the `"close"` listener bound to `this.onMessage` (line 21 removed), which was incorrect, and now removes the `"message"` listener bound to `this.onMessage` (line 21 added), which is also incorrect. The correct listener to remove is the `"close"` event listener bound to `this.onClose`.

summary.problem: The dispose method removes the wrong event listener, leaving the socket with a dangling listener and breaking cleanup.
summary.done_well: The change attempts to fix an incorrect listener removal, but introduces a new incorrect one.
